snippet.title: Grandpa High on Retro - Official Trailer ( Max Payne meets GTA San Andreas )
snippet.description:
Download Grandpa High On Retro on STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967320/Grandpa_High_on_Retro/


Grandpa will have a visually stunning retro third-person action-adventure campaign that will keep you on the edge of your seat, with semi open linear level environments with very good world-building and storytelling. Grandpa will have intensely gratifying gameplay experience blending Retro graphics with modern third person mechanics.
